import json, hashlib, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

repo=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/"src"))
from do_again.service.rollout import _tree_hash

key=hashlib.sha256(str(repo.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
root=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key
state=root/"state"
outbox=state/"browser_outbox"
uncertain=state/"browser_delivery_uncertain.json"

def read_json(p):
    try:
        v=json.loads(p.read_text())
        return v if isinstance(v,dict) else {}
    except Exception:
        return {}

head=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout.strip()
source_hash=_tree_hash(repo/"src/do_again")
runtime_hash=_tree_hash(root/"runtime/do_again")
items=sorted(p.name for p in outbox.glob("*.json")) if outbox.is_dir() else []

print(json.dumps({
  "repo_head":head,
  "source_hash":source_hash,
  "runtime_hash":runtime_hash,
  "runtime_matches_source":source_hash==runtime_hash,
  "outbox_items":items,
  "uncertain_exists":uncertain.is_file(),
  "uncertain":read_json(uncertain) if uncertain.is_file() else None,
  "browser_status":read_json(state/"browser_status.json"),
  "liveness":read_json(state/"liveness.json"),
},indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print("SELF_POST_RECONCILIATION_RUNTIME_AUDIT_OK")
